svg.data-material: Steel, aluminum and plastic T-shaped cable guides
svg.data-finish: Black or Glacier White powder coat paint
svg.data-cable-capacity-basis: Cat 6 (0.250 in OD) at the maximum fill the maker's cable fill table gives (the 50% fill of the usable area, 39.6 sq in); its recommended fill for the same cable is 202
svg.data-environment: Indoor use only, in environmentally controlled areas
